details:
Q1: Which part of the repository should this issue improve?
Choices:
A) The review/autofix pipeline (`review_autofix.yml`, reviewer/editor scripts)
B) The orchestrator and poller (`orchestrate_poll.yml`, `scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh`)
C) The clarify/plan/implement phases (`clarify.yml`, `plan.yml`, `implement.yml`)
D) Documentation only (README.md, agents.md, docs/)
E) Something else: please name the file, workflow or behaviour in the issue body (RECOMMENDED)
Q2: What does "better" mean for that target?
Choices:
A) Fix a specific bug or failure (please link the failing run, issue or PR) (RECOMMENDED)
B) Lower cost or runtime (API calls, model spend, wall-clock time)
C) Improve reliability or security hardening
D) Improve readability or documentation, with no change in behaviour
Q3: What observable result should mark this issue as done?
Choices:
A) A specific acceptance criterion written into the issue body, such as a test that passes or a metric threshold (RECOMMENDED)
B) A named failing run or alert stops recurring
C) No explicit criterion; the reviewer decides when it is good enough
**Note:** C cannot be verified, so it is likely to need clarification again during planning.
